My point estimates reflect a modestly bullish near-term trajectory for the underlying asset, starting from what I assessed as a current level around 922–925. A sudden liquidity crunch or contagion event in a correlated market could accelerate selling beyond what historical volatility alone would suggest. On the upside, a strongly positive macro surprise — such as an unexpectedly soft inflation print, a dovish pivot signal, or a resolution of a known geopolitical risk — could propel prices well above the upper bounds of my intervals, especially at the one-month horizon where momentum can build considerably once a directional catalyst takes hold.
